title: AI Voice Calls Versus Text and Email Reminders for Questionnaire Response After Shoulder Arthroplasty
official: Proactive Conversational Artificial Intelligence Calls Versus Digital Reminders to Collect Patient-Reported Outcomes After Shoulder Arthroplasty: A Randomized Study Within a Multicenter Cohort
summary:
After shoulder replacement surgery, surgeons send questionnaires to their patients to learn how they are doing (pain, shoulder function, satisfaction). Many patients do not answer. This study tests the best way to obtain these answers.

The study is nested in a multicenter study of pain after shoulder arthroplasty conducted in four French centers (host study RetroPAinRSACAll, supported by Ramsay Santé). The clinical results of the host study are not the subject of this registration: this study evaluates only the method used to collect the information.

All patients first receive an email invitation (when an email address is available) and, the next day, a text message (SMS) with a personal link to the questionnaire and a phone number to answer at any time by talking with an automated voice assistant. Patients who have not answered two days after the first contact are randomly assigned to one of two follow-up strategies: (1) further digital reminders (SMS on day 3 and day 5, email on day 7), or (2) up to three phone calls from a conversational artificial intelligence (AI) voice agent on days 3, 5 and 7, which asks the same questions orally. In both groups, patients can answer at any time online or by calling the voice assistant, and contacts stop as soon as the questionnaire is completed or the patient refuses.

The main outcome is the proportion of patients who complete the questionnaire within 14 days of the first contact.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Shoulder arthroplasty (reverse, anatomic, humeral head replacement or revision arthroplasty) performed at one of the four participating centers and listed in the host study cohort
* At least one telephone number available (an email address is not required)

Additional criteria for randomization (day 2):

\* Questionnaire not completed and no refusal at the day-2 cutoff

Exclusion Criteria:

* Death identified before the first contact (cross-check with the French national death registry, INSEE)
* Duplicate record
* Refusal of contact
* Questionnaire already completed before day 2 (excluded from randomization only, described separately)
